text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the new semester heading into the 
Senior Year, 
a certain new student came visiting the 
trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl from Morioka
text_block_list.text:
Miss Yukino! 
I made it too, by golly! 
All the way from Morioka to Central!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You're... oh my goodness~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who asked that question 
back at the Morioka festival...!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl from Morioka
text_block_list.text:
Yes!  
Thank you so much 
for answerin' me that day!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl from Morioka
text_block_list.text:
That gave me all the courage I needed. 
I'll be in your care from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Awwwww...! 
A girl from Morioka...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If you're ever in a pinch, ask me 
anything! 
I am your senior, after all...! 
Ehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: From that day forward...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl from Morioka
text_block_list.text:
Holy moly! My time dropped! 
Your teachin' is downright incredible, 
Miss Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aw, shucks, it's nothin' special! 
I'm just passin' along what Trainer taught 
me...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do a tandem run! 
I'll take the outside lane, so try your 
hardest not to let me pass you!
choice_data_list: She's really giving it her all...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
'Cherry Blossom Strawberry... Wasanbon, 
Sweet Red Bean Paste, Cream Cappuccino' 
...This must be this month's seasonal 
special!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl from Morioka
text_block_list.text:
You sure know all the fanciest things, 
Miss Yukino! 
Phew~, this is mighty tasty. 
Reminds me of the sakura mochi from the 
sweets shop back home...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I used to go there all the time too! 
Their ocha mochi is real good too, y'know~

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl from Morioka
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Hehe... You really are 
a Morioka horsegirl through and through, 
Miss Yukino. 
I wonder if I can be like you someday...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl from Morioka
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it won't just be me, either. 
Lots more girls will look up to you and 
head for the big city sayin', 
'I wanna do that too!'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Yukino Bijin was becoming an 
approachable role model— 
an inspiration in a way distinct from a 
mythical legend like Saint Lite.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had built real strength, and more and 
more people 
were seeing her for the runner she truly 
was. 
A few days after feeling those bright 
beginnings...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—A racing magazine... 
wants to do a special feature on me...?
choice_data_list: Yeah, an inquiry actually came in...
Yeah, an inquiry actually came in, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rather than focusing on the "Snow Angel" 
buzz, they want 
to do a deep dive into her everyday 
training regimen 
and her upcoming races.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well color me surprised... 
For 'em to go outta their way to ask for 
somethin' like that.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, so... does that mean they're really, 
truly payin' attention to my actual 
runnin'!? 
Is that it!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
According to the reporter, they want to 
introduce her as one 
of the "true powerhouses" driving the 
local horsegirl boom. 
Apparently—
choice_data_list:
There are horsegirls across the whole 
nation who look up to you!

There are horsegirls across the whole 
nation who look up to you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Gosh, that kinda sounds 
just like how I used to be, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
For me, it all started 
when I saw City-san in a magazine, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Could I really be that spark... 
for someone far away out there...? 
Could I really be that for them...?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Alrighty then! Let's do this!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna talk a whole heap about racin'! 
I'll show the whole country that I've got 
real, 
proper substance to back myself up, too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
As a proud "city girl" representin' 
everyone 
who came from the regional circuits to 
shine in the Central!
